reviewer.method: Second pass on the re-encoded sample (sha256 109d9399…, verified against evidence.json output_sha256). Opened all 42 fresh phase PNGs, re-extracted 2 fps frames from all 14 continuous clips and built 10 fps tile sheets for shots 1-5, 7, 8, 10-13; ran freezedetect-style per-frame difference (YAVG per 0.5 s) and changed-pixel bounding boxes on every span where a change or a suspected static hold mattered; re-measured audio with ebur128, per-shot volumedetect, 0.5 s head/tail windows and silencedetect, and re-measured the Ryan V4 reference the same way. Each of the author's claimed fixes was checked against the new frames; nothing was carried over from the first file without re-verification. Sound was measured, not listened to: intelligibility, prosody and sync were not auditioned by ear.
